title: City Talks AIDS Impact, Budget & Growth
summary:
*   A City Manager's report on the critical impact of AIDS was presented and discussed.
*   Officials continued an in-depth worksession focused on the city's annual budget.
*   Budget discussions specifically included presentations from land development and planning departments.
transcript:
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING CONTINUED FROM lAugust 27, 1987
AUGUST 27, 1987 - 9:00 A.M.
Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin. Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order the special called meeting of the Council which was a continuation of the
worksesslon on the budget begun on August 26, 1987.
A City Manager report was given on the Impact of Aids.
The budget worksesslon was continued with reports from Office of Land Development Services
and Planning and Growth Management.
.
All members of the Council were present for the continued worksession.
ADJOURNMENT
Council adjourned its meeting at 12:40 p.m.
